evidence: Isolation: task/task.toml:26-28 has [verifier] timeout_sec = 13200.0, environment_mode = "separate"; task/tests/Dockerfile:43 'COPY . /tests' builds the verifier's own image, and the agent image (task/environment/Dockerfile) copies only instructions/ and assets/. Credentials: task/task.toml:30-35 reads REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". The five key lines diff empty against the frozen block in references/staged-task-contract.md:67-71 (the contract's header carries only an explanatory comment), and task.toml differs from the frozen template task.toml only in [task]/[metadata] identity fields (name, description, keywords, difficulty, difficulty_explanation, category, provenance, arena_slice); file is ASCII with no CR. The token is a ${VAR} template, not a literal; grep for sk-or-/sk-ant-/allowed_hosts over task.toml and tests/ returns nothing. judge.toml: all five files have 'judge = "claude-code"' at line 2 (the expected fallback, matching REWARDKIT_JUDGE); grep -E '^\s*(model|reasoning_effort|temperature|weight ...)' style key search for model/REWARDKIT/ANTHROPIC/api_key/base_url finds only that line, and a case-insensitive count of glm|openrouter|z-ai is 0 in each file; the [judge] headers are identical to the template headers. Pinning: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template; bases 'node:22-bookworm-slim' and 'python:3.12-slim' are version-tagged, npm installs are all @version (@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1), pip is 'harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7', and Chromium is installed by the pinned @playwright/mcp's bundled playwright CLI. Network: [environment] and [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public", no allowlist, which the workbook row and SKILL.md line 26 say is correct. test.sh:63-64 aborts if REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL are unset, and the app is launched under 'env -i' (lines 104, 160) so the judge credentials are not passed to the submitted app. Notes (not defects, no measurement waived for this row): (1) base images are pinned by tag, not digest, and apt packages are unpinned; this is template-controlled, and the workbook's check-dockerfiles row treats unpinned apt as NOTE. (2) No configured judge run exists on these exact bytes, so that ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} actually resolves and authenticates at grade time is shown only by the hosted run on an earlier candidate (result.json/reward.json hashes verified), whose [verifier.env] wiring is the same shared block; live launch evidence belongs to row 22 and the runtime records, and this row's requirements are static configuration facts that were all checked directly. Counterexamples tried: a judge.toml carrying a model override (none present), an env block with reordered/extra keys or a literal key (none), a verifier sharing the agent container (environment_mode is separate), an unpinned 'npm install -g pkg' or 'pip install pkg' (none).
